# Daniel Hasdiel — CV

> Personal CV site for Daniel Hasdiel, a software developer building
> command-and-control systems for autonomous robotics (Algolight/Shor,
> IDF Robotics & Automation). Single page: work history, skills, education,
> army service, projects.

## Machine-readable resume

AI agents can read the resume as structured data — no auth, read-only:

- MCP endpoint: `/mcp` (POST, streamable HTTP)
  - `get_resume` — full resume as JSON
  - `get_section` — one section: work | army | skills | education | projects | summary | contact
  - `get_contact` — email, phone, GitHub/LinkedIn/X links
- GraphQL: `/graphql` — the `me` query returns the same structured resume
- The same MCP tools are exposed to in-page agents via WebMCP
  (`navigator.modelContext`, loaded from `/mcp?webmcp-script`)

## Pages

- `/` — the entire CV; browser print produces a clean A4 one-pager

## Notes

- Single source of truth: `src/data/resume-data.tsx` — page, GraphQL, and MCP
  all read from it.
